posts.text: Introducing 3D Make in Kimi. Kimi connects to tools like Blender and CAD tools to create models, assemble scenes, and develop games. Available now on https://t.co/Q150OaO4ww and Kimi Work. https://t.co/pwmv4Ccn00

Ah yes, the world you build can live on your PC using Kimi’s new 3D Make. LLMs use tools to build worlds, not code or framegen. Describe a scene, and Kimi can use code and tools to build it 🌀 Blender for geometry, materials and lighting 📐 CAD tools for dimensioned parts 🧊 3D generators for characters and complex assets 🎮 Game engines for scenes and gameplay With Kimi Work or Code, it can operate locally installed software and iterate on projects stored on your computer. Prompt → editable assets + code → your hardware renders the scene. This isn’t local Kimi inference. Creation and AI-assisted edits still depend on its service. Physics, believable motion and polished visuals still need work. But an editable project running on your hardware is a meaningful outcome. AI builds the world. Your machine runs it. https://t.co/eNm4qwkMfS
